lanes.spec:
COMMON RULES as in every lane:
- hostless for all code, including any python3;
- cua-x11-session.sh for every Driver/Chromium run; telemetry off; TMPDIR=/mnt/zer0models/cua-lane-tmp/b05;
- build 'flock cargo-build.lock build-driver.sh <wt> b05-<sha9> cua-release-r2-10', cargo lock before quiet lock;
- timing via bin/quiet-timed (EXCLUSIVE, at most 25 min per acquisition); shakedowns and controls SHARED;
- packet docs/experiments/b-05-browser-mcp-transport-2026-10-03/ in kvnloo/cua PR #106 layout, packet-local .gitignore (!*.log, !build/), verifier fails on ignored-but-cited files;
- mirror to artifacts/r2/B-05/; commit identity and trailer; no push; privacy on every commit.

HYPOTHESIS. COMP's MCP transport in/out decomposes into three parts: (i) an IRREDUCIBLE stdio floor (pipe syscalls + framing for the exact payload bytes), (ii) Driver-side serialize/write cost that grows with payload size, and (iii) caller-side Python MCP client read/parse cost. At least one part beyond the floor is deletable without changing outputs. Resolution and admission residual similarly split into floor and deletable work.

SOURCE. Worktree w4-b05-mcp-transport on new branch exp/b-05-browser-mcp-transport-20261003 from 8f3a646b4818b757648835cf89db8886626b1cf0 (R2-10's tested source R).
- cherry-pick 194a6342e (N-02 MCP span marks + CL knob, default off). Resolve phase_trace.rs as the union and record it.
- Add one measurement-only, env/trace-gated, default-off commit with Driver-side spans for browser tools:
  - stdin frame read complete, JSON-RPC parse done, admission enter/exit, tool dispatch enter/exit;
  - resolution sub-marks (ref lookup, snapshot-store lookup, CDP node resolve);
  - result serialize done, stdout write+flush done.
- Caller-side stamps (harness only): request serialize, write, first byte read, frame complete, parse done, validation done.
- Both sides use CLOCK_MONOTONIC.
- Binary B5 is the only binary in every arm. Record sha256 + in-session version.
- Default-off smoke vs R (bin/cua-driver-r2-10-8f3a646b4, sha256 12b9045a): tools/list byte-identical, and fill/toggle/modal 5/5 with identical receipts.

PREREG.json is committed before the first Phase A trial. Configuration = R2-10 COMP exactly, scripted chooser (jev-use choose_mock_for_task), classes fill/toggle/modal; harness reused from the R2-10 packet harness/.

PHASE A, attribution (BENCHMARK).
- 32 rounds per class, COMP with marks on.
- Instrumentation-overhead control: marks-off vs marks-on, 20 AB/BA pairs per class. Overhead >0.5 ms is reported and subtracted.
- STDIO FLOOR HARNESS (FIXTURE): a minimal Rust (or C) stdio echo process replays the Driver's recorded response frames, byte-identical, through the same Python MCP client stack and the same pipe setup. Same payload sizes per call. This gives the per-call irreducible pipe+framing+client-parse floor for the exact payloads, with no Driver change.
- Output: per-call and per-task sub-span means with bootstrap CI, sub-span share of mean T_runner, and coverage >=0.97 of T_runner.

PHASE B, causal A/B.
- Before any Phase B trial, commit PREREG-AMENDMENT-1.json. It names one candidate deletion per sub-span with mean >=1.0 ms above its floor, its knob/arm, and the equivalence rule.
- Candidates the amendment may choose from (it must justify the choice from Phase A):
  - caller-side JSON parse/validation replacement (caller-only; outputs compared);
  - MCP client stdio read buffering/chunk size (caller-only);
  - Driver compact vs pretty serialization or pre-serialized single write_all + flush (measurement-only Driver knob, default off);
  - removing duplicated text content when structuredContent is present (changes the output contract, so at most OWNER_DECISION);
  - resolution caching of the snapshot-store lookup within one call.
- Each candidate: 30 AB/BA pairs per class, under quiet-timed. Fresh Driver, Chrome and fixture per trial; loadavg per trial; every trial kept.

ORACLE. jev-use fixture server journal, read every 2 ms by an independent harness thread (fill: submitted == token; toggle: checked; modal: opened and modal). Route attribution from receipts: browser_type trusted_input, browser_click dom (dom_event, click.cdp_send mark).

CONTROLS.
- Equivalence: for caller-side or serialization arms, every response is byte-identical or identical under the pre-registered canonical-JSON compare, on 100% of calls.
- N4a, 5 per class per B arm: refusal semantics unchanged (browser_ref_stale, effect=refused).
- Default-off smoke.
- Negative: an injected malformed frame must still be rejected by every caller-side variant (10 per variant).

GATES (pre-registered).
- A sub-span is DELETED (KEEP) iff its saving is >=0.5 ms mean with 95% CI excluding 0, validity is 100%, equivalence is 100% and the controls pass.
- IRREDUCIBLE iff the sub-span is within the floor (its CI overlaps the floor harness value) or every tested candidate fails.
- OWNER_DECISION iff the deletion changes the public output contract.
- Report the recomputed scripted untested share per class for R2-10 COMP mapped onto this lane's binary. E2 target: <5%.

CLAIM BOUNDARY. One host, private Xvfb, scripted chooser, binary B5 (R + marks). Nothing is ratioed against R2-10's binary; verdicts carry to the wave-5 composition only by cherry-picking the knob commits onto R'.

EVIDENCE CLASSES: BENCHMARK+REAL (FIXTURE), FIXTURE (floor harness), UNIT, SOURCE, NOT_RUN.

PACKET must state: forced path, route/producer, oracle, controls, tested source SHA, Driver sha256 + version, environment and loadavg, live heads at start/end (upstream main, trycua/cua PR 4316), publication SHA (by Publish), claim boundary. Work deleted separate from wall-clock saved.

PART A, ARMS per task (GTK3 checkbox toggle, text entry; R2-04 tasks):

- X+HCL: caller-compiled output validators compiled lazily per schema at first use, INSIDE T;
- X+V: CUA_DRIVER_EXP_ADMISSION_TOOLS_CACHE=1;
- X+HCL+V.
Design:
- 4-arm Williams order, 24 rounds per task, giving >=24 pairs per contrast.
- Primary amortization k=1: one task per Driver session, fresh Driver and fixture per trial, as R2-10.
- Secondary block k=5 tasks per session, 12 sessions per arm per task. Report per-task T with first-use compile inside T, and the session total.
- Loadavg per trial; every trial kept.

ORACLE. CUA_GTK3_TASK_STATE file, fresh per trial, read every 2 ms by an independent harness thread. Route from receipts (click/set_value accessibility) and the full R2-04 mark sequence.

CONTROLS.
- HC equivalence: lazy validators give the same verdict as the library on 100% of calls. Corpus of 10 injected invalid outputs per tool: both reject.
- V: tools/list cache stays correct. 5 rows where the tool set is re-listed mid-session: admission still validates against the current list, or the lane documents the knob's invalidation scope from SOURCE.
- Native focus steal at ~100 ms after the state change, 5 per task per arm, restored.
- Default-off smoke.

GATES (pre-registered).
- HCL is DELETED (KEEP) iff the net saving at k=1, including first-use compile, is >=5 ms with 95% CI excluding 0, equivalence is 100% and validity is 100%. If the net saving is positive only at k=5, the verdict is OWNER_DECISION (session-shape dependent) and both numbers are reported.
- V is DELETED iff its saving is >=1 ms with CI excluding 0 and its control passes. NOT_MATERIAL if the CI includes 0 and the upper bound is <1 ms.
- Recompute untested share for both tasks on the best arm; split action transport into Driver serialize/write, pipe, client read/parse and validation using the N-02 span marks. Target <5%.

PART B, R2-09 ax_fg ROUTE.
- Add an env-gated, default-off fixture variant with actionable elements that are not showing or have no usable bounds: a checkbox and a button inside a GtkScrolledWindow scrolled out of view, or another construction that the SOURCE path decide_foreground_element_placement routes to ax_fg.
- Pilot (excluded, SHARED) to confirm the route: the receipt says the accessibility route with delivery foreground, and a do_action_replied mark is present. Any global_input row is refused from analysis.
- Arms: B (default 50 ms post-DoAction sleep) vs S0 (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_NATIVE_POST_ACTION_SLEEP_MS=0). 20 AB/BA pairs per element type, fresh Driver and fixture per trial, quiet-timed.
- Oracle: the fixture's state file with a CLOCK_MONOTONIC effect timestamp written by the app's signal handler. Metric: effect visible at tool return (t_effect <= t_return as read by the 2 ms sampler) and the margin.
- Gate, R2-09 rule:
  - S0 is DELETED on ax_fg iff visible-at-return is 20/20 per element type and the minimum margin is >=1 ms;
  - otherwise the sleep is IRREDUCIBLE on ax_fg (KILL S0 there);
  - an oracle publication-lag exception is classified only by the pre-registered rule.
- Controls: route check, default-off smoke, and a positive control with an injected 30 ms app-side delay that S0 must expose as not visible at return (it shows the oracle discriminates).

CLAIM BOUNDARY. GTK3 AT-SPI on X11 (private Xvfb), binary N3, scripted, no provider. Native live arms stay BLOCKED (budget). Nothing is ratioed against R2-10's binary.

EVIDENCE CLASSES: BENCHMARK+REAL (FIXTURE), UNIT, SOURCE, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN.

COMMON RULES as in every lane:
- hostless for all code, including any python3;
- cua-x11-session.sh; telemetry off; TMPDIR=/mnt/zer0models/cua-lane-tmp/b04;

SOURCE AND BINARY. Packet branch exp/b-04-observation-reconcile-20261003 from 8f3a646b4818b757648835cf89db8886626b1cf0, worktree w4-b04-obs-reconcile.
- Binary R = /mnt/zer0models/github/cua-lanes/bin/cua-driver-r2-10-8f3a646b4, sha256 12b9045aafddd208c7aeb7e49d5a2e5ab7e776c07ec6d7bd62322807291458a9. It already carries the B-01 marks and the B-02 sub-span marks. Not rebuilt; re-hash and read the version in session.
- Harness from the B-03 packet (exp/b-03-toggle-cold-snapshot-20261002: run_b03.py, plus B-02 run_b02/run_critpath copied into the packet), pointed at R.
- Configuration = R2-10 COMP, scripted chooser (best composed configuration).

PREREG.json is committed before the first measured trial. It includes the estimator definition: excess = first-snapshot observation span minus the matched re-snapshot span, both from Driver trace marks, plus the caller-side T_oracle rule.

PROBES, classes fill and toggle; modal as a third class for the D0 contrast only, as a consistency check.
- P1 negative control (estimator validity): same document, no navigation; snapshot pairs at D = 80 ms and D = 160 ms after navigate return. 30 pairs per D per class.
- P2 per-process contrast at D0: cold process (fresh Chrome) vs warm process. The warm process first loads a matched-content sibling page: same DOM structure and roles, different text/tokens, served by the fixture. It then navigates to the task page. Measure excess(cold, D0) - excess(warm, D0). 30 AB/BA pairs per class.
- P3 per-document: warm process, a new document via navigate vs re-snapshot of the same document at D0. 30 AB/BA pairs per class.
- P4 T_oracle rule: arms W0 (COMP as is), W80 (80 ms wait after navigate) and PREWARM (sibling warm-up inside T). 30 rounds per class, Williams order.
- Fresh Driver and fixture per trial; loadavg per trial; every trial kept.

ORACLE. jev-use fixture server journal read every 2 ms by the independent harness thread (fill: submitted == token; toggle: checked). Snapshot spans from Driver trace marks. Route from receipts (dom_event clicks, trusted_input typing).

CONTROLS.
- P1 is itself the negative control. Its gate: |mean excess| < 1.0 ms with 95% CI including 0, per class and D.
- Positive control: an injected 20 ms server-side delay on the first document response must appear as excess (CI excludes 0) in 10/10 pairs per class.
- Default config smoke on R, 5 per class.

VERDICT MAPPING (pre-registered).
- If P1 fails, the estimator is invalid. Fall back to the pre-registered second estimator: Driver-side walk duration marks only. If that also fails P1, the verdict is UNDECIDED and the lane says so; no carry-over.
- Per-document part: IRREDUCIBLE iff every tested deletion (W80, PREWARM) increases median T_oracle with a CI excluding 0. Otherwise UNDECIDED, with numbers.
- Per-process part (P2 contrast):
  - OWNER_DECISION (browser process reuse / warm-pool policy) iff the contrast is >=1 ms with CI excluding 0;
  - NOT_MATERIAL iff the CI includes 0 and the upper bound is <1 ms;
  - DELETED never, because no product knob is proposed.
- Fill and toggle are decided by the same rules in the same block.
- Output: the updated R2-10 E2 observation row per class (scripted and live) and recomputed untested shares on R.

CLAIM BOUNDARY. One host, private Xvfb, Chromium 151, binary R, scripted. No product change; the warm pool is a policy question for the owner.

EVIDENCE CLASSES: BENCHMARK+REAL (FIXTURE), SOURCE, NOT_RUN.

SOURCE. Worktree w4-own20g-guard on exp/own-20g-guard-final-diff-20261003 from 0f1955d2f1ee2b01b40775aa53ea2af0b5544218 (current upstream main; this is a product fix candidate).
- U = 0f1955d2f + cherry-pick 28b915ae9 (R2-04 marks), b9b357bc7 (N-01R knobs), 194a6342e (N-02 settle_poll marks + CUA_DRIVER_EXP_FOCUS_GUARD_CLAMP). All are measurement-only and default off. Record conflicts with PR 4375 in raw/.
- G = U + one reviewed fix commit in platform-linux input/focus_guard.rs. When the settle loop exits on its deadline (including after a stalled X call) with no change seen, it takes one final focus diff before reporting. A steal found then is restored and reported as focus_outcome=restored. No other behaviour changes, and no new timer beyond the single final diff.
- Builds U and G; record sha256 + in-session versions.

PREREG.json is committed before the first counted REAL row. It includes the window-validity rule below.

UNIT (red/green). A new test with an injected stall: a fake focus source whose call blocks past watch_until while the focus changes during the stall. Fails on U, passes on G. All existing focus_guard tests and the platform-linux lib pass on G. Keep the logs, force-added.

REAL R1 (stall row).
- Reproduce c08-017: a harness X client issues XGrabServer for ~2.0 s, starting ~100 ms into the guard's watch. The decoy (a pre-mapped harness window: EWMH activate + raise + XSetInputFocus) steals focus at ~217 ms.
- Tasks: GTK3 checkbox (S0) and text (X).
- Arms U vs G AB/BA, n=20 per arm per task.
- Oracle: independent 2 ms X focus sampler (xprobe.py verbatim from N-02). Pass = the decoy stole focus, the final (focus, active) equals the pre-trial reference (the sampler's first sample after GTK settles), and the receipt says focus_outcome=restored. The task state file is verified too.
- Gate: G 20/20 per task. U's miss count is reported as the default-guard finding.

REAL R2 (CL re-test; only after UNIT and R1 pass).
- Arms G vs G+CL (CUA_DRIVER_EXP_FOCUS_GUARD_CLAMP=1), for checkbox S0 and text X.
- The steal is triggered from the Driver-side do_action_replied mark by a separate process tailing the trace, at delays 216, 220, 225, 230, 235, 240, 245 ms (the band), plus a 205-215 ms edge and a 100 ms decoy.
- Window-validity rule (pre-registered): a trial counts for safety iff the sampler shows the steal landed inside [guard start, watch_until + final diff].
- n >= 20 valid steals per band cell group (band pooled; edge and 100 ms separately) per arm per task. Invalid trials are kept and reported.
- Separate timing block, no steals: G vs G+CL, 24 AB/BA pairs per task, quiet-timed, loadavg per trial.
- Gate: CL KEEP iff valid trials have 0 misses in both arms AND the timing saving is >=10 ms with 95% CI excluding 0 AND validity is 100%. Otherwise KILL. Misses are classified by the pre-registered rule, never post hoc.

REAL R3 (#20 a11y bus restart, new).
- In the private session, kill the AT-SPI accessibility bus dbus-daemon (the at-spi-bus-launcher's bus, not only registryd) and relaunch the bus and the registry mid-session. The GTK3 fixture keeps running or is respawned per the pre-registered variant.
- Then: get_window_state, and a click using an element token minted before the restart.
- Pass:
  - the Driver returns either a fresh truthful tree (digest equals the fixture-declared elements and the state file) or a structured error;
  - the pre-restart token is refused (never acts);
  - 0 mutations from stale authority;
  - after a fresh observation, a new token verifies.
- n=20 on G and 20 on U.
- Controls: noop (no restart) 10; registry-only restart 10 (the inherited OWN-20 row).
- Kill only processes this lane started inside its own private session.

E4 counters per arm: silent steal misses, stale-token actions, unverified successes.

CLAIM BOUNDARY. Linux X11 (private Xvfb, openbox), GTK3 fixture, binaries U/G built from 0f1955d2f. The fix is a fork candidate only. Hyprland/Wayland focus rows are BLOCKED (real seat).

EVIDENCE CLASSES: UNIT, REAL (FIXTURE), REAL+BENCHMARK, SOURCE, BLOCKED.
